title: Angled and negative work
target: Use force direction to determine work’s sign and size.
criteria: Explain positive, negative and zero work.

authoring.limitations: Reasoning evidence only. Multiple choice does not certify physical performance. Teacher reviews before assigning and rates mastery separately.

cpa.prompt: A sled moves west while a rope’s force points west. What is the sign of rope work?
options: Cannot be positive because west is negative on one axis.
cpa.guide: Work sign depends on relative force and displacement directions, not the chosen axis sign.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A cart moves north while a braking force points south. What sign is the braking work?
options: Its sign depends only on the cart’s mass.
cpa.guide: Opposite force and displacement produce negative work.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 25 N angled force has a 15 N component along a 4 m displacement. What is its work?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A 20 N force makes 60° with a 3 m displacement. Use cos 60° = 0.50. What work does it do?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A box moves 5 m horizontally. Its upward normal force is 40 N. What is work by the normal force?
cpa.guide: The normal force is perpendicular to the horizontal displacement.
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Apply the physical relationship to new data.

cpa.prompt: A pulling force does +52 J while friction does −19 J. No other force does work. What is net work?
cpa.freshness: New scenario and/or model data, independently answerable without worksheet answers.

demand.evidence: Compare evidence and identify a physical relationship.
